seoTitle: Palette Contrast Matrix: WCAG Ratios for Every Color Pair
metaDescription: Paste a colour palette and see the WCAG contrast ratio of every pair with AA and AAA marks for text, large text and UI components.
intro: Find out which combinations in your design system are accessible, instead of checking pairs one by one.
why:
Enter colours as hex values, optionally with names. The tool computes WCAG 2.x relative luminance contrast for every pair, shows a compact matrix (AAA, AA, large text or UI only, fail), a sorted list with pass levels for normal text (4.5:1 AA, 7:1 AAA), large text (3:1 AA, 4.5:1 AAA) and UI components (3:1), and lists the pairs safe for body text. The ratios match the contrast checker tool.

WCAG 2 contrast has known limits (it ignores font weight, polarity and perceived lightness); APCA is an alternative being studied. Contrast is only one part of accessibility.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter 2 to 24 colours, one per line.
Read the matrix and the sorted list.
Pick pairs that pass for text.
Adjust colours that fail with the colour tools.
